panels.title: Connector fleet (Kafka Connect)
panels.description: Every connector on the Connect cluster. Health is DEGRADED when the connector runs but a task failed or is missing: a connector can be RUNNING while its tasks are FAILED.

targets.expr: (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"failed"}) * 3) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"paused|stopped"}) * 1) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"unassigned|restarting"}) * 2) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 2 * clamp_max((sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_failed_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) > bool 0) + (sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_running_task_count{connector=~"$connector"}) < bool sum by (connector) (kafka_connect_worker_connector_total_task_count{connector=~"$connector"})), 1)) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 0)

(max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"running"}) * 0) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"paused"}) * 1) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"stopped"}) * 2) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"unassigned"}) * 3) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"restarting"}) * 4) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"failed"}) * 5) or (max by (connector) (kafka_connect_connector_status{connector=~"$connector",status=~"destroyed"}) * 6)

panels.title: Connector health over time
panels.description: Flapping between OK and DEGRADED means a task keeps failing and being restarted (for example by a watchdog).

panels.title: Debezium capture engines (by logical server = topic.prefix)
panels.description: Debezium's own streaming metrics, one row per logical server. A connector whose task is FAILED has no engine row. The Connector column is filled when the connector sets custom.metric.tags=connector=<name>.

panels.title: Source lag (seconds behind the source database)
panels.description: MilliSecondsBehindSource: commit time in the source vs processing time in Debezium. Dashed lines at 10 s and 30 s.

panels.title: Time since last event
panels.description: Grows while the source tables do not change. Only a concern when changes are expected.

panels.title: Internal queue used (%)
panels.description: Debezium's queue between the database reader and Kafka. Near 100% means Kafka (or the Connect producer) is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Capture errors and erroneous events (per 5 min)
Oracle LogMiner (Oracle connectors only; other plugins show no data)
Active transactions in buffer
panels.description: Long-running uncommitted transactions held in Debezium's buffer

panels.title: SCN gap (current - offset)
panels.description: How far the connector's resume position is behind the database's current SCN

panels.title: Records written to Kafka / delivered by sinks (/s)
In-flight records (polled, not yet acknowledged)
panels.description: Grows when Kafka acknowledges slower than the connector polls

panels.title: Task running ratio
panels.description: Share of time the tasks spent RUNNING (1 = always)

panels.title: Errors, retries and dead letter queue
Record errors (per 5 min)
panels.description: Conversion / transformation errors. Skipped records only happen with errors.tolerance=all.

panels.title: Producer send errors and retries (/s)
panels.description: Errors here mean records could not be written to Kafka

panels.title: Dead letter queue (per 5 min)
panels.description: Only for connectors with errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name (sink connectors)
